fluff.overview: Lyran infantry draw confidence from knowing their equipment is first-rate, even when assigned to garrison duty on worlds far from the front lines. Foot infantry platoons form the backbone of the LCAF's garrison forces, deploying on foot to hold positions, patrol perimeters, and secure urban areas where vehicles cannot easily operate. Armed with assault rifles and Blazer laser rifles that combine two emitters into a single devastating energy weapon, these platoons mix conventional ballistic firepower with high-energy precision shots. These special operations fireteams are small, highly trained units configured for reconnaissance, sabotage, and direct action behind enemy lines, relying on stealth and precise execution rather than conventional firepower.
